description: This Java source file defines the GLIMContainer class, which serves as a data container for grouping information related to Group Lending Issue Managers (GLIM) within the loan portfolio. It holds identifiers, account details, a list of child loan accounts, parent principal amount, and loan status.

classes.name: GLIMContainer
classes.description: A data container class that encapsulates details related to a GLIM group, including identifiers, account number, child loans, parent amount, and status.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the group ID associated with the GLIM.

methods.name: getAccountNumber
methods.description: Returns the account number for the GLIM.

methods.name: getChildGLIMAccounts
methods.description: Returns the list of child loan account summaries under this GLIM group.

methods.name: getLoanStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the loan.
